economy.summary: His campaign says residents deserve to live in a place they can afford, and he centers his platform on addressing the rising costs facing families in the district.
economy.short: Says residents deserve affordability; centers platform on rising costs.

taxes.summary: He says the state must invest additional funding in public education to reduce pressure on the local property taxes that fund school districts.
taxes.short: Says state education funding should reduce local property tax pressure.

education.summary: He supports investing additional state funds in public education, and says cyber charter school tuition should align with the actual cost of an online education rather than fund advertising, executive salaries, and for-profit management fees.
education.short: Supports public education funding; wants cyber charter tuition reform.

energy.summary: He says he would seek legislation to place extreme limits on future data center installations to protect the environment, health, and residents' wallets.
energy.short: Says he would seek extreme limits on future data centers.

guns.summary: An avid hunter, he supports restoring Pennsylvania's traditional hunting schedule, specifically returning the start of deer season to a Monday, which he says matters to his constituents. This is a hunting position filed under public safety.
guns.short: Supports restoring deer season's traditional Monday start.

economy.summary: Her campaign says she will cut wasteful spending policies that she says have increased costs and hurt affordability.
economy.short: Says she will cut wasteful spending that raised costs.

taxes.summary: Her campaign says she will reduce taxes for hardworking families and seniors on fixed incomes.
taxes.short: Supports reducing taxes for families and seniors on fixed incomes.

abortion.summary: Her campaign says she will defend the sanctity of human life.
abortion.short: Says she will defend the sanctity of human life.

energy.summary: Her campaign says she supports smart economic growth policies while preserving farmland.
energy.short: Supports smart economic growth while preserving farmland.

guns.summary: Her campaign says she will defend Second Amendment rights and provide funding for police officers, firefighters, and first responders.
guns.short: Says she will defend Second Amendment rights, fund first responders.
